title: Pancakes
hook: 今天是做薄饼的日子，猪爸爸自称翻饼高手，结果把饼翻到了天花板上。

cells.a: She says today is a day for pancakes!

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig ask Daddy Pig?
cells.a: She asked him, “Are you sure, Daddy Pig?”
cells.cn: 她问他：“你确定吗，猪爸爸？”

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig put in the bowl?
cells.a: She added an egg and then gave it all a stir.
cells.cn: 她加了一个鸡蛋，然后把面糊搅匀。

cells.q: What is Mummy Pig going to do?
cells.a: She is going to flip the pancake over.

cells.q: Who is the first pancake for?
cells.a: The first pancake is for Peppa, with syrup on it.
cells.cn: 第一张薄饼给佩奇，上面还浇了糖浆。

cells.a: It is for Mummy Pig, and Daddy Pig's is next.
cells.cn: 这张给猪妈妈，下一张就是猪爸爸的。

cells.q: What happened to Daddy Pig's pancake?
cells.a: He flipped it a bit too high and it did not come down.
cells.cn: 他翻得太高，饼就没掉下来。

cells.q: How do they get the pancake down?
cells.a: They all have to jump up and down until it falls.
cells.cn: 大家得一起跳，把它震下来。

cells.q: Where did Daddy Pig's pancake land?
cells.a: It landed on his head, so now he has his pancake.
cells.cn: 饼正好落在他头上，他终于拿到自己的饼了。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: pancake, egg, stir, flip, syrup, high
helper.actions: make, add, stir, flip, jump, catch

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Pancakes”.
ending: In the end, the pancake lands on Daddy Pig's head. My favourite part is ______.
